decisions.after: Tianzuo, having regained the troops of Linya Yelü Dashi and also obtained the troops of Moheshi of the Shiwei people at Yinshan, considered himself aided by Heaven and again planned to send out troops and recover Yan and Yun.
decisions.reason: The literal field should preserve the Linya title while correcting Shiwei, removing [9], and attaching 歸 to the troops' return of allegiance.

decisions.reason: 舍利詳穩 is a Khitan office, sheli xiangwen, and has nothing to do with Buddhist relics.

decisions.reason: The literal field contains the same false expansion of the Khitan office 舍利詳穩 as a Buddhist relic.
